latestVersion.changelog:
clothing-magic-remover-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for AI-based accessory and partial clothing removal from images.
- Supports submitting a person photo URL and optional description of clothing to remove.
- Maintains realistic body textures and proportions in the processed images.
- Requires API key for authentication (set as WESHOP_API_KEY).
- Endpoints provided for launching jobs, uploading images, and polling status.
